proposed_widenings.name: UseCountCap.ability_modifier.minimum
proposed_widenings.justification: The existing ability-modifier use-count cap cannot express the RAW floor of at least one use, so encoding the feature today would produce false 0-or-fewer-use states for low-Wisdom rangers.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once)

notes: Nature's Veil otherwise fits the existing class_feature activation surface: bonus action, self-target, apply Invisible, long-rest reset. I did not author content JSON because the resource cap cannot be encoded honestly without a minimum floor.
